Class PathData

java.lang.Object
icyllis.arc3d.sketch.PathData
@ThreadSafe public final class PathData extends Object
Immutable container for path geometry data: points, verbs; and cached values that computed from above two arrays: bounds, segment masks; and lazily computed values: convexity.

All of the public factories check for valid input

  • valid verb sequence
  • corresponding # points
  • finite point values
If any of these checks fail, null is returned.

A valid sequence of verbs (and corresponding points) is: 

 Any number of contours (0 or more)
 ... Each contour must begin with a single Move verb
     ... followed by any number of segments: lines, quads, cubics (0 or more)
     ... followed by 0 or 1 Close verb
A minor exception to these rules, is that the last contour may end with a single Move verb -- this will be included in the resulting PathData, but will be ignored in computing 'trimmed' bounds, getBounds(Rect2f).

Given a valid verb sequence, there must be the corresponding number of points to match. If there are more or fewer, null is returned.

    • equals

      public boolean equals(Object o)
      Returns true if two PathData have equivalent path segments. That is, they have equal verb array and point array. Floating-point coordinates follow IEEE comparison semantics: any comparison involving NaN evaluates as unequal, including NaN with itself, whereas +0.0f and −0.0f compare equal.
